content.short: Dexed offers an all-in-one token explorer with analytics and an event tracker across multiple blockchains.
content.description: Dexed is a token terminal built for active traders, delivering fast, multi-chain analytics to identify trending tokens across networks like Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and ZKsync. Its powerful analytics surface momentum signals and key metrics that help you spot potential opportunities quickly. An integrated event tracker highlights the major events that have driven price moves over the past month, giving you context for how tokens react to news and developments. Explore, compare, and stay informed in one dashboard.
content.meta: Dexed is a token terminal with analytics to surface trending tokens across multiple blockchains. Discover Dexed and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
